{{Top}}
[[File:Kaadu_eggpic.jpg|thumb|right|A kaadu egg]]
{{Quote|Hey, those are ''eggs''! Did ''you'' guys lay them?|[[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], stumbling across the secret nest of [[Dordi]], [[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Wilyem]] and [[Zal]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
An '''egg''' was a method of giving birth among some [[Species/Legends|species]]. Rather than giving live birth, a member of an egg-laying species would lay an egg containing the young, within which the young would grow to term and hatch. Some species of [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] and [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] such as [[monotreme]]s but all [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]], [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] and [[Bird/Legends|avian]] species were known lay eggs, such as [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]], [[S'kytri]], [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]], [[marlello]]s, [[Nuna/Legends|nunas]], [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]], [[Geejaw/Legends|geejaws]], and [[fanback]]s.

Many species ate eggs of other creatures as a form of sustenance. Scrambling eggs was one alternate means of preparing them prior to consumption.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref> [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] were particularly fond of eggs, especially those of the Quor'sav.

The [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] and the Nediji worshiped a deity known as the [[Cosmic Egg]].
